quote:
When new areas are being developed, irrigation engineers and agronomists need 
to determine the potential area that can be irrigated and the capacities of the 
canals that will be needed through estimates of the proportion of annual runoff 
that will be diverted, its distribution in time, and the characteristics of the area to 
be cropped (including soil water-holding capacity).
raw_name: divertible annual runoff; runoff timing; soil water-holding capacity
note: Direct potential-area assessment guidance; multi-variable use, no sign/threshold supplied. Spate family has parked wording; no unpark or runtime surface.

quote:
In existing schemes estimates 
of potential cropped areas should at least be verified by comparison with currently 
cropped areas.
note: Use existing cropped area to verify potential-area estimates; not hard mask excluding expansion.
Direct intake siting guidance but local channel geometry/flow paths exceed broad landscape raster precision. Not a generic distance-to-river cutoff.
